messages.en:
{07 14 00}No one ever tells me which
piece of furniture in my
house they like the best.
But, {01 00 00 03 00}as one of my best
buddies, {01 00 00 03 00}you'll tell me,
{07 0b 00}right? {02 04 00 ff ff}
Sure.
Not now.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Keegi ei ütle mulle kunagi,
milline mööbliese mu majas
neile kõige rohkem meeldib.
Aga, {01 00 00 03 00}ühe mu parima
sõbrana {01 00 00 03 00}sa ütled,
{07 0b 00}eks? {02 04 00 ff ff}
Ikka.
Mitte praegu.

messages.en:
Hey, do you like any of my
furniture? {01 00 00 05 00}Please let me
know if you do!{02 04 00 ff ff}
Uh, OK.
Leave me alone!
messages.et:
Hei, kas sulle meeldib mõni
mu mööbel? {01 00 00 05 00}Anna palun
teada, kui meeldib!{02 04 00 ff ff}
Ee, olgu.
Jäta mind rahule!
